review_scope: Separate-context engineering review with historical context; no blind semantic adjudication, human agreement, or model/training independence claim.

source_publication.reviewer_verification: Independently read already-fetched Git object locally; same complete tree and module hash. No reviewer GitHub/network request.

validation_boundary.independent_validation: Twelve focused fake-HTTP/token probes plus exact-source review and historical baseline reproduction. Author reports are not presented as independently rerun.
validation_boundary.final_canary_commitment: Source verified: mandatory canary acceptance plus all 28 author acceptances are committed by final corpus receipt.

handoff.actionability: Exact source/configuration, local resource and schema checks, fresh ordered execution, EB isolation, and corpus-freeze stop are actionable.
handoff.sequencing_clarification: Parent reports freeze-before-canary sequencing clarification applied to the later final handoff; this reviewer did not retest that documentation as source.

limits: Real provider schema-feature support and completion capacity remain unobserved.
Prompt token observations do not prove untruncated request consumption.
Corpus semantics, privacy/historical separation, and semantic-assessor qualification remain unassessed.
Local hashes/reconstruction do not authenticate a provider after coordinated rewriting of all records and external source authority.
archive_note: The two .py.txt files are byte-identical review-code archives, not maintained or test-discovered source. They can be executed explicitly with Python. FILE-MAP.json preserves original-name and hash mappings.
